t: The ReMarkable Paper Pro is one of my favorite tech products in years | CNN Underscored
s: September 29, 2025 - The one problem with a massive leap forward in tech is that it often comes at the expense of backwards compatibility. Such is the case with the ReMarkable Paper Pro, which you can’t buy without a stylus — because the original styli don’t work with it. Sure, I can imagine a hypothetical where someone wants two of these tablets but only one pen, but it’s very unlikely.
